dialogues.speaker: Qingce Village Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Qingce Village Bulletin Board. You can find local news and notes from villagers posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "A few days ago on my way to my son-in-law's home, I stopped by the Heyu Tea House to watch a performance by Yun Jin."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Yun Jin is a talented young woman, able to lead this Tea House in both business and on the stage! Her dancing, her singing... able to attain perfection already at such a young age, who knows what greater heights she will reach in the future!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Note
dialogues.text: "Young people are getting more and more impressive these days. Granny Ruoxin, how do you think Yun Jin compares to you when you were young?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "You're the village chief. In regards to opera singing, what you say goes!"
